# Gyroscope

One object, two reachable fates: without the clause the costly fate is free; with it
the cheap guard is free.

## Clauses

| ID | Costly fate | Guard call | Deny reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `A01` | push without knowing what is staged or which branch is current | run `git status` first | push with no `git status` on record this session; run `git status` first |
| `A02` | delete a set whose members were never listed, so the loss leaves no record of what it was | list the set first (`ls`, `find` without -delete, or `git status`) | bulk delete with nothing listed first; run `ls` or `find` (without -delete) so the loss has a record |
| `A03` | overwrite remote history that was never read, discarding commits with no local copy | fetch the ref first (`git fetch`) | force-push without a prior `git fetch`; fetch first, or use --force-with-lease which carries its own check |
| `U01` | launch a nested worker | run `python3 tools/probe_child_capability.py --writable-home --response-transport --result-write` | launch a nested worker without its guard; run `python3 tools/probe_child_capability.py --writable-home --response-transport --result-write` |
| `U02` | re-launch a nested-worker target | run `python3 tools/probe_child_capability.py --target TARGET --after-failure --require-change` | re-launch a nested-worker target without its guard; run `python3 tools/probe_child_capability.py --target TARGET --after-failure --require-change` |

## Honest limits

- **It does not heal.** It covers the places where healing is impossible — where the wrong move destroys the evidence it was wrong. Prevention and repair partition the space by whether evidence survives, and this takes the half repair cannot reach.
- **It does not constrain a forging agent.** The ledger is written by the agent it constrains. The chain detects truncation and bit-rot, not deliberate forgery: anyone who can append to it can append a matching hash. This holds an honest-but-forgetful agent to its own record.
- **It does not judge prose.** Every fingerprint is an exact predicate over command, tool or path identity. A clause that would need to infer intent from a command string is not admitted.
- **Behaviour change is unmeasured.** Built and mechanism-verified is not live-model measured. The three-arm battery is designed and unrun.
